sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position and will be heavy favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and have won only once all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could have title-race implications, with Stafford looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, face Eccleshall at home in a contest between two of the division's stronger sides. In-form Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community to what should be a routine home fixture for the visitors. Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a mid-table clash. At the lower end, struggling Shawbury United (on a six-game losing streak) travel to Brereton Social, while Widnes Town, with just 2 points from 7 games, visit Brereton Social on Saturday. Cheadle Heath Nomads face Telford Town in a battle between two of the league's weakest performers. Market Drayton Town host New Mills, and Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in two mid-to-lower-table fixtures. The midweek game sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community on Wednesday evening.
